children: Asian currencies are mixed against the dollar, but may be weighed by higher prospects of Fed rate hikes. U.S. data released overnight showed core inflation was 0.3% on month in September, above consensus estimate for a 0.2% on month increase, CBA's Samara Hammoud notes. "Markets are now pricing a 34% chance of an October interest rate hike, compared with 20% before the data," the international economist and currency strategist says in a research report. The dollar falls 0.3% to 157.86 yen, but is 0.7% higher at 1,347.60 won, while the Australian dollar declines 0.2% to US$0.6952, LSEG data show. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
